text:
Maya (Product): Heads up — planning thread for next cycle: we need a concrete plan for API auth + tenant controls across hosted/dedicated/private. main asks from customers: scoped keys per-project, read-only keys for embeddings, rotation without downtime, and auditability.

Sam (Eng): We should list constraints early. scoped keys => routing + policy checks on every request. perf impact if we add DB lookup per token.

Chris (Security): Agreed. minimal surface: API key metadata (org_id, project_id, scopes, created_by, expires_at). KMS/HSM for signing tokens in private deployments. audit logs mandatory.

Maya (Product): Proposed options to evaluate:
- Option A: API keys with metadata + server-side lookup (safer, easier revocation)
- Option B: self-contained JWT keys signed by our KMS (no lookup, but revocation complexity)
- Option C: hybrid: short-lived JWT + long-lived lookup token for rotation window

Anna (PM): Launch criteria we care about: (1) revoke immediately (no active calls allowed after revoke), (2) rotation path that doesn't require client reissue for embedded devices, (3) console + API parity for key ops, (4) docs + SDK changes minimal. prioritize for Hosted first, Dedicated next, Private last.

Sam (Eng): Implementation notes:
- For Option A: we can add a lightweight cache (LRU) to avoid DB hit every call. invalidation on rotate via notify channel.
- For Option B: support "jti" blacklist for revocation but that implies a lookup on revoke - so not really lookup-free.

Chris (Security): Private deployments will mandate KMS/HSM integration. For Dedicated we can allow Redwood-managed KMS but with customer key wrapping. Also need key rotation policy: forced rotate every X days + grace window for active streams.

Josh (SRE): Operational impact: key rotation can break long-lived streaming sessions. We need a graceful fallback: when a key is rotated, continue accepting existing SSE/websocket streams for up to N minutes or until reconnect. But for security-sensitive customers we should allow immediate cut. Need per-tenant config.

Maya (Product): Customers asking specifically about embeddings and billing: they want read-only keys that can only call embeddings endpoints and can be embedded in client apps. That implies scope enforcement at request layer (e.g., scope contains: embeddings:read, completions:write).

Sam (Eng): Example header proposal: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` + optional `X-Project-ID: <project>` for legacy customers. SDKs should prefer scopable keys so clients don't need to send X-Project-ID.

Chris (Security): Also require "kid" in key metadata so we can rotate KMS signing keys without reissuing API keys.

Maya (Product): Prioritization ask: 1) Scoped keys for hosted (embeddings-only & project-scoped) 2) Rotation API + console UX 3) Revocation semantics + streaming policy 4) Dedicated: integration docs + managed KMS 5) Private: HSM + on-prem sync.

Anna (PM): Customer-driven asks mapping:
- Startup A: needs per-project keys and console UI => aligns with 1 & 2
- Enterprise B: requires HSM + immediate revoke => needs 3 & 5
- Platform C: wants read-only embedding keys for client SDKs => 1

Sam (Eng): Rough effort notes (very rough):
- Scoped keys + cache + basic UI: 3 sprint-ish (small team)
- Rotation API + automatic rotation flow: 2 sprints
- Streaming graceful fallback logic: 1 sprint + test matrix
- Dedicated KMS support: 2 sprints + infra ops
- Private HSM sync: depends on customer (estimate 3-5 sprints)

Chris (Security): Compliance items: audit trail with user/actor, key lifecycle events (create/rotate/revoke), retention policy exportable to SIEM. Also require rotation logs to be signed.

Maya (Product): UX notes: in console key view show: scopes, created by, last used, project assignment, revoke button, rotate button (one-click). Rotation should optionally create a new key and mark old key as rotated for X window.

rotations-bot: [automation] Created ticket RED-4523 to track Scoped Keys (hosted) implementation.

Josh (SRE): Monitoring + alerting: spike in 401s after rotation = rollout problem. add dashboards per-tenant for failed auths and key churn.

Anna (PM): For launch docs: sample flows + migration guide. e.g.:

1) current header: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`
2) new scoped key example: `Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...`
3) sample scope enforcement: `scopes: ["embeddings:read"]`

Also include snippet for rotation endpoint:
```
POST /v1/keys/rotate
{
  "key_id": "k_abc123",
  "grace_window_seconds": 300
}
```

Sam (Eng): Open questions for engineering sign-off:
- cache TTL default? (5s/30s/1m)
- should rotations be immediate or grace-by-default?
- streaming behavior per-tenant override?

Maya (Product): Proposed decisions for planning:
- Cache TTL = 30s with push invalidation on revoke/rotate.
- Rotation default = graceful 5min window, but admin can set immediate cut.
- Streaming: allow configurable grace per-tenant.

Chris (Security): I support TTL 30s + notify channel. Also require replay resistance: include nonce in HMAC for some private flows.

Sam (Eng): ok i'll sketch an architecture doc and break into stories. will include perf benchmark plan for cache hit vs full lookup.

Maya (Product): Great. Next steps: Sam to produce RFC by EOW, Anna to draft launch criteria + migration guide, Chris to list compliance checklist, Josh to propose monitoring dashboards.

Anna (PM): :thumbsup: Adding this to roadmap doc. Thanks all.
